examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
11
new 2
put 1 10
put 2 20
get 1
put 3 30
get 2
get 3
put 4 40
get 1
get 3
get 4
examples.display:
calls   = LFUCache(2), put(1, 10), put(2, 20), get(1),
          put(3, 30), get(2), get(3), put(4, 40), get(1),
          get(3), get(4)
results = null, null, null, 10, null, -1, 30, null, -1, 30, 40

put(3, 30) removes key 2, used once. When put(4, 40) comes, keys 1 and 3 both have two uses; key 1 was used longest ago, so it goes.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.input:
9
new 2
put 1 1
get 1
get 1
put 2 2
put 3 3
get 1
get 2
get 3
examples.display:
calls   = LFUCache(2), put(1, 1), get(1), get(1), put(2, 2),
          put(3, 3), get(1), get(2), get(3)
results = null, null, 1, 1, null, null, 1, -1, 3

Key 1 has three uses and stays, though key 2 was used more recently. A recently-used cache would have removed key 1.
